Camera: Camera COMP to render from (position, rotation and FOV are read live). Empty = built-in orbiting camera.
Orbitspeed: Built-in camera orbit speed in degrees per second. Only used when Camera is empty.
Maxdist: Maximum ray distance in world units; rays beyond it count as misses (background).
Maxsteps: Maximum raymarch steps per pixel. Higher = fewer holes at grazing angles, slower.
Epsilon: Hit threshold in world units. Smaller = sharper, more precise surfaces but needs more steps.
Stepscale: Multiplier on each raymarch step. Below 1 is safer for twisted, noisy or repeated fields; 1 = fastest.
Lightazimuth: Key light direction around the vertical axis, in degrees.
Lightelevation: Key light height above the horizon, in degrees (90 = straight down).
Shadows: Soft-shadow hardness. Higher = sharper shadows; 0 = shadows off.
Ao: Ambient occlusion strength darkening crevices. 0 = off.
Reflectivity: Mirror reflection of the environment, with boosted fresnel at grazing angles. 0 = none.
Background: What shows on a miss. env: the in2 environment (or built-in sky). solid: Bgcolor.
Bgcolor: Background colour used when Background is solid.
Fogcolor: Colour that distant surfaces fade to when Fog is above 0.
Gamma: Output gamma applied after ACES tonemapping. 2.2 = standard display; 1 = linear output.
Alphabg: On: misses output alpha 0 (transparent background) instead of the background colour.
